answer: Sybil resistance follows from reputation’s exponential temporal half-life: an identity’s influence decays continuously unless it sustains honest, reciprocated service over time. In the EigenTrust graph, a freshly spawned sybil is a nearly isolated vertex with near-zero eigenvector centrality; it has no credible path to amplify trust, whether disguised as a relic or polished with quartz, and therefore cannot pass consensus.
